title: Fort Témiscamingue Blacksmith Forge

terrainReference.basis: Sample the approach west of the future entrance at the original contemporary site coordinates.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named forge feature and measured excavation of the nineteenth-century forge
mapIdentity.scope: A 7.10 m by 6.30 m archaeological envelope at the mapped forge center. Historical turnover and the surviving mapped exhibit make the exact position approximate.

note: The excavated timber building is one storey with a gable roof, centred west door under a canopy, one adjacent west window and a south gable fireplace. The report measures the rubble fireplace base at 2.05 m by 1.37 m.
